services.title: Texas Franchise Tax
services.summary: Franchise tax filings and refunds in Texas.
services.text: If your gross receipts total more than $1,400,000 in Texas you owe a 1% state franchise tax. We handle the filing and look for refunds.
services.lead: If your gross receipts total more than $1,400,000 in Texas you are required to pay a 1% state franchise tax to the Texas Comptroller's office, a minimum of $14,000.00 in extra taxes. We handle the filing, and look at whether a refund or an avoidance strategy applies to you.

covers.title: The threshold
covers.text: Gross receipts above $1,400,000 in Texas bring the franchise tax into play.

covers.title: What it costs
covers.text: The tax runs at 1% to the Texas Comptroller's office, a minimum of $14,000.00 in extra taxes.

covers.title: Refunds and strategy
covers.text: We look at whether a refund is available to you, and at the tax avoidance strategy that fits your business.

about.title: About Platinum Tax Relief, Inc
text: Welcome to Platinum Tax Relief, Inc, the premier destination for tax preparation services. Our experienced tax preparers are here to help you navigate the complexities of tax law and find the best solutions for your unique situation.

Platinum Tax Relief, Inc provides comprehensive tax negotiation, preparation and avoidance services to small businesses and consumers across all 50 states. Our team of tax preparers, Enrolled Agents and tax professionals have served before the IRS, and we understand the tax laws and regulations that apply in each state.

We take a personalized approach. Every individual and business has unique tax needs, so we take the time to listen to your concerns, analyze your financial situation and develop strategies that are in your best interest. Platinum Tax Relief is owned and operated by Black accountants.
